The package-scoped rule retains Node code, metadata and licenses. The default 512 MiB/30000-file guard and offline Claude executable remain intact. Actual installed serializer and non-target preservation tests pass; removing the rule produces the intended behavioral assertion failure and exact-byte restoration passes. The current macOS staging measurement is 514131629 bytes/22626 files, 9046804 bytes smaller. Signing, feed, publication and installed update behavior are unchanged by this source edit. All 25 server-build-portability tests passed on the local macOS host, including self-contained server/worker execution from unrelated cwd and concurrent fixture listener ownership. This is packaged Node fixture evidence, not a signed/native installed artifact.
